scope: capturing and decoding the server-to-client packet stream
tool_change: ring_bridge forward gained --dump-in <path>; every injected server packet is stored as JSONL {length,state,hex}

encoding.packet: u32 outgoingSequence (plain) + encoded body; CODOL_NetchanSubmit wraps it in fragments (sequence|0x80000000 header)
encoding.xor: key = (uint8_t)(challenge ^ outgoingSequence); for each byte: key ^= lastClientCommandString[j] << (i&1); data[i] ^= key; j resets on NUL/end
